text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Secondary school protests grow. Demonstrators threatened that unless Education Minister Sofija Todorova resigns, they will demand the resignation of the entire government. The protest leadership has asked to meet Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov.
- The Macedonian parliament decided on Wednesday to ask the government to include in its denationalisation bill the return of the property of the Macedonian Orthodox Church.

- If the artwork owned by Bitola pensioner Blagoja Jankulovski was really made by Leonardo Da Vinci, it could be worth 90 million dollars, says deputy general manager of the Museums of Macedonia, who will ask Jankulovski to show the piece in public.
